verses.geez: ዕበዱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ያጠፍእ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ወለእግዚአብሔር፡ ያስተጋፍዖ፡ በልቡ።

translations.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
translations.ron: Mai de preţ este săracul care umblă intru neprihănirea lui, decât un bogat cu buze viclene şi nebun.

verses.geez: ባዕል፡ ይዌስክ፡ አዕርክተ፡ ብዙኀነ፡ ወነዳይሰ፡ ኪያሁኒ፡ ዘቦ፡ የኃጥእ።

translations.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
translations.ron: Neştiinţa sufletului nu este bună iar cel ce umblă repede dă greş.

verses.geez: ሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ርኩስ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወዘየኃሥሥ፡ በግፍዕ፡ ኢያመስጥ።
verses.translation: The folly of a man spoils his ways: and he blames God in his heart.

translations.lxx: The folly of a man spoils his ways: and he blames God in his heart.
translations.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
translations.ron: Nebunia omului dărâmă calea lui şi inima lui se mânie împotriva Domnului.
translations.grk: Ἀφροσύνη ἀνδρὸς λυμαίνεται τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ, τὸν δὲ Θεὸν αἰτιᾶται τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወብዙኃን፡ ይትለአኩ፡ በቅድመ፡ ነገሥት፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ጽድቁ፡ ወሀብቱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር።
verses.translation: Wealth acquires many friends; but the poor is deserted even of the friend he has.

translations.lxx: Wealth acquires many friends; but the poor is deserted even of the friend he has.
translations.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
translations.ron: Bogăţia strânge prieteni fără de număr, iar săracul se desparte chiar de prietenul său.
translations.grk: Πλοῦτος προστίθησι φίλους πολλοὺς, ὁ δὲ πτωχὸς καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὑπάρχοντος φίλου λείπεται.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ፡ እኩይ፡ ይከውን፡ ዝንጓጔ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘአኃወ፡ ነዳያነ፡ ይጸልእ፡ እምታአኅኃሁ፡ ርኁቅ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that accuses unjustly shall not escape.

translations.lxx: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that accuses unjustly shall not escape.
translations.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
translations.ron: Martorul mincinos nu va rămâne nepedepsit şi cel ce spune lucruri neadevărate nu va scăpa.
translations.grk: Μάρτυς ψευδὴς οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ὁ δὲ ἐγκαλῶν ἀδίκως οὐ διαφεύξεται.

verses.geez: ሕሊና፡ ሠናይት፡ ለእለ፡ አጥረይዋ፡ ትቀርብ፡ ወብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይረክባ።
verses.translation: Many court the favour of kings; but every bad man becomes a reproach to another man.

translations.lxx: Many court the favour of kings; but every bad man becomes a reproach to another man.
translations.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
translations.ron: Mulţi sunt cei ce linguşesc pe un om darnic şi toţi sunt prieteni ai celui ce dă daruri.
translations.grk: Πολλοὶ θεραπεύουσι πρόσωπα βασιλέων, πᾶς δὲ ὁ κακὸς γίνεται ὄνειδος ἀνδρί.

verses.geez: ዘብዙኅ፡ እከዩ፡ ይፌጽም፡ እከየ፡ ወዘያስዖዝዝ፡ ነገረ፡ ኢይድኅን።
verses.translation: Every one who hates his poor brother shall also be far from friendship. Good understanding will draw near to them that know it, and a sensible man will find it. He that does much harm perfects mischief; and he that uses provoking words shall not escape.

translations.lxx: Every one who hates his poor brother shall also be far from friendship. Good understanding will draw near to them that know it, and a sensible man will find it. He that does much harm perfects mischief; and he that uses provoking words shall not escape.
translations.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
translations.ron: Toţi fraţii celui sărac îl urăsc; cât de mult prietenii lui se depărtează de el! El caută vorbe (mângâietoare), dar nu le află.
translations.grk: Πᾶς ὃς ἀδελφὸν πτωχὸν μισεῖ, καὶ φιλίας μακρὰν ἔσται· ἔννοια ἀγαθὴ τοῖς εἰδόσιν αὐτὴν ἐγγιεῖ, ἀνὴρ δὲ φρόνιμος εὑρήσει αὐτήν· ὁ πολλὰ κακοποιῶν τελεσιουργεῖ κακίαν, ὃς δὲ ἐρεθίζει λόγους, οὐ σωθήσεται.

verses.geez: ዘአጥረያ፡ ለጥበብ፡ ያፈቅር፡ ነፍሶ፡ ወዘያፈቅር፡ አእምሮ፡ ይረክብ፡ ኄረ።
verses.translation: He that procures wisdom loves himself; and he that keeps wisdom shall find good.

translations.lxx: He that procures wisdom loves himself; and he that keeps wisdom shall find good.
translations.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
translations.ron: Cel ce dobândeşte înţelepciune iubeşte sufletul său şi cel ce ţine cu tărie la pricepere află fericirea.
translations.grk: Ὁ κτώμενος φρόνησιν ἀγαπᾷ ἑαυτὸν, ὃς δὲ φυλάσσει φρόνησιν, εὑρήσει ἀγαθά.

verses.geez: ሰማዕተ፡ ኀሰት፡ ኢይድኅን፡ እምኵነኔ፡ ወዘያስተውዕያ፡ ለእከይ፡ ይተኃጐል፡ ባቲ።
verses.translation: A false witness shall not be unpunished; and whosoever shall kindle mischief shall perish by it.

translations.lxx: A false witness shall not be unpunished; and whosoever shall kindle mischief shall perish by it.
translations.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
translations.ron: Martorul mincinos nu rămâne nepedepsit şi cel ce spune lucruri neadevărate se va prăbuşi.
translations.grk: Μάρτυς ψευδὴς οὐκ ἀτιμώρητος ἔσται, ὃς δʼ ἂν ἐκκαύσῃ κακίαν, ἀπολεῖται ὑπʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez: ኢይደልዎ፡ ለዐብድ፡ ተድላ፡ ወለእመ፡ ገብረ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘምስለ፡ ጽእለት፡ ትኄየል።
verses.translation: Delight does not suit a fool, nor is it seemly if a servant should begin to rule with haughtiness.

translations.lxx: Delight does not suit a fool, nor is it seemly if a servant should begin to rule with haughtiness.
translations.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
translations.ron: Nu-i stă bine celui fără de minte să trăiască în desfătări, cu atât mai puţin unui rob să conducă peste căpetenii.
translations.grk: Οὐ συμφέρει ἄφρονι τρυφὴ, καὶ ἐὰν οἰκέτης ἄρξηται μεθʼ ὕβρεως δυναστεύειν.

verses.geez: ወሐሪ፡ ብእሲ፡ ይትዔገሥ፡ ወትምክሕተ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ይትቃወሞሙ፡ ለኃጥአን።
verses.translation: A merciful man is long-suffering; and his triumph overtakes transgressors.

translations.lxx: A merciful man is long-suffering; and his triumph overtakes transgressors.
translations.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
translations.ron: Înţelepciunea domoleşte mânia omului şi faima lui este iertarea greşelilor.
translations.grk: Ἐλεήμων ἀνὴρ μακροθυμεῖ, τὸ δὲ καύχημα αὐτοῦ ἐπέρχεται παρανόμοις.

verses.geez: መዓተ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ከመ፡ ጣሕረ፡ አንበሳ፡ ወከመ፡ ጠል፡ ዘይወርድ፡ ዲበ፡ ሣዕር፡ ከማሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ውኅዋኄሁ።
verses.translation: The threatening of a king is like the roaring of a lion; but as dew on the grass, so is his favour.

translations.lxx: The threatening of a king is like the roaring of a lion; but as dew on the grass, so is his favour.
translations.kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
translations.ron: Furia unui rege e ca răcnetul unui leu, iar bunăvoinţa lui este ca roua pe iarbă.
translations.grk: Βασιλέως ἀπειλὴ ὁμοία βρυγμῷ λέοντος· ὥσπερ δὲ δρόσος ἐπὶ χόρτῳ, οὕτως τὸ ἱλαρὸν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ኃፍረት፡ ለአብ፡ ዐብድ፡ ወልድ፡ ወኢኮነ፡ ንጹሐ፡ ጸሎት፡ ምስለ፡ ዐስበ፡ ከልአት።
verses.translation: A foolish son is a disgrace to his father: vows paid out of the hire of a harlot are not pure.

translations.lxx: A foolish son is a disgrace to his father: vows paid out of the hire of a harlot are not pure.
translations.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
translations.ron: Lenea te face să cazi în toropeală; sufletului trândav îi va fi foame.
translations.grk: Αἰσχύνη πατρὶ υἱὸς ἄφρων, οὐχ ἁγναὶ εὐχαὶ ἀπὸ μισθώματος ἑταίρας.

verses.geez: አብያተ፡ ወንዋየ፡ ይከፍሉ፡ አበው፡ ለውሉዶሙ፡ ወባሕቱ፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ትትዋደዶ፡ ብእሲት፡ ለብእሲሃ።
verses.translation: Fathers divide house and substance to their children: but a wife is suited to a man by the Lord.

translations.lxx: Fathers divide house and substance to their children: but a wife is suited to a man by the Lord.
translations.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
translations.ron: O casă şi o avere sunt moştenire de la părinţi, iar o femeie înţeleaptă este un dar de la Dumnezeu.
translations.grk: Οἶκον καὶ ὕπαρξιν μερίζουσι πατέρες παισὶ, παρὰ δὲ Κυρίου ἁρμόζεται γυνὴ ἀνδρί.

verses.geez: ምምዓ፡ ይእኅዞ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ፅኑስ፡ ወነፍስ፡ ዘኢይትቀነይ፡ ይርኅብ።
verses.translation: Cowardice possesses the effeminate man; and the soul of the sluggard shall hunger.

translations.lxx: Cowardice possesses the effeminate man; and the soul of the sluggard shall hunger.
translations.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
translations.grk: Δειλία κατέχει ἀνδρόγυνον, ψυχὴ δὲ ἀεργοῦ πεινάσει.

verses.geez: ዘየዓቅብ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ ወትእዛዘ፡ ይትመኀፀን፡ ነፍሶ፡ ወዘያሰትትሰ፡ ፍናዊሁ፡ ይትኃጐል።
verses.translation: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall perish.

translations.lxx: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall perish.
translations.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
translations.ron: Cel ce ia seama la poruncă îşi păstrează sufletul său, iar cel ce dispreţuieşte cuvântul (Domnului) va muri.
translations.grk: Ὃς φυλάσσει ἐντολὴν, τηρεῖ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ψυχήν· ὁ δὲ καταφρονῶν τῶν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδῶν, ἀπολεῖται.

verses.geez: ይሌቅሖ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ዘይምሕር፡ ነዳየ፡ ወበከመ፡ ሀብቱ፡ ይፈድዮ።
verses.translation: He that has pity on the poor lends to the Lord; and he will recompense to him according to his gift.

translations.lxx: He that has pity on the poor lends to the Lord; and he will recompense to him according to his gift.
translations.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
translations.ron: Cel ce are milă de sărman împrumută Domnului şi El îi va răsplăti fapta lui cea bună.
translations.grk: Δανείζει Θεῷ ὁ ἐλεῶν πτωχὸν, κατὰ δὲ τὸ δόμα αὐτοῦ ἀνταποδώσει αὐτῷ.

verses.geez: ዝብጥ፡ ወልደከ፡ ከመ፡ ይኩንከ፡ ለተስፋ፡ ወለተጽእሎሰ፡ ኢታልዕል፡ እዴከ።
verses.translation: Chasten thy son, for so he shall be hopeful; and be not exalted in thy soul to haughtiness.

translations.lxx: Chasten thy son, for so he shall be hopeful; and be not exalted in thy soul to haughtiness.
translations.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
translations.ron: Pedepseşte pe feciorul tău, cât mai este nădejde (de îndreptare), dar nu ajunge până acolo ca să-l omori.
translations.grk: Παίδευε υἱόν σου, οὕτως γὰρ ἔσται εὔελπις, εἰς δὲ ὕβριν μὴ ἐπαίρου τῇ ψυχῇ σου.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ እኩይ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ያኃጒል፡ ወእመሰ፡ ዓቢይ፡ ሕቡል፡ ነፍሶሂ፡ ይዌስክ።
verses.translation: A malicious man shall be severely punished, and if he commit injury, he shall also lose his life.

translations.lxx: A malicious man shall be severely punished, and if he commit injury, he shall also lose his life.
translations.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
translations.ron: Omul aprig la mânie trebuie să fie pedepsit; dacă îl cruţi o dată, trebuie să începi din nou.
translations.grk: Κακόφρων ἀνὴρ πολλὰ ζημιωθήσεται· ἐὰν δὲ λοιμεύηται, καὶ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ προσθήσει.

verses.geez: ስማዕ፡ ወልድየ፡ ተግሣፀ፡ አቡከ፡ ከመ፡ ትኩን፡ ጠቢበ፡ በደኃሪትከ።
verses.translation: Hear, son, the instruction of thy father, that thou mayest be wise at thy latter end.

translations.lxx: Hear, son, the instruction of thy father, that thou mayest be wise at thy latter end.
translations.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
translations.ron: Ascultă sfatul şi primeşte învăţătura, ca să fii înţelept toată viaţa ta.
translations.grk: Ἄκουε, υἱὲ, παιδείαν πατρός σου, ἵνα σοφὸς γένῃ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτων σου.

verses.geez: ብዙኅ፡ ሕሊና፡ ውስተ፡ ልበ፡ ብእሲ፡ መምክር፡ ወምክሩሰ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ይሄሉ፡ ለዓለም።
verses.translation: There are many thoughts in a man's heart; but the counsel of the Lord abides for ever.

translations.lxx: There are many thoughts in a man's heart; but the counsel of the Lord abides for ever.
translations.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
translations.ron: Multe puneri la cale frământă inima omului, dar numai sfatul Domnului se împlineşte.
translations.grk: Πολλοὶ λογισμοὶ ἐν καρδίᾳ ἀνδρὸς, ἡ δὲ βουλὴ τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα μένει.

verses.geez: ፍሬሁ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ምጽዋት፡ ይኄይስ፡ ነዳይ፡ ጻድቅ፡ እምባዕል፡ ሐሳዊ።
verses.translation: Mercy is a fruit to a man: and a poor man is better than a rich liar.

translations.lxx: Mercy is a fruit to a man: and a poor man is better than a rich liar.
translations.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
translations.ron: Omul se face plăcut prin mărinimia lui; mai de preţ este un sărac bun decât un om mincinos.
translations.grk: Καρπὸς ἀνδρὶ ἐλεημοσύνη, κρείσσων δὲ πτωχὸς δίκαιος ἢ πλούσιος ψευδής.

verses.geez: ፈሪሀ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ሕይወተ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘኢይፈርህሰ፡ የኃድር፡ ውስተ፡ መካን፡ ኀበ፡ ኢያስተርኢ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: The fear of the Lord is life to a man: and he shall lodge without fear in places where knowledge is not seen.

translations.lxx: The fear of the Lord is life to a man: and he shall lodge without fear in places where knowledge is not seen.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
translations.ron: Frica de Dumnezeu duce la viaţă şi ne îndestulăm fără să fim loviţi de nenorocire.
translations.grk: Φόβος Κυρίου εἰς ζωὴν ἀνδρὶ· ὁ δὲ ἄφοβος αὐλισθήσεται ἐν τόποις οὗ οὐκ ἐπισκοπεῖται γνῶσις.

verses.geez: የኀብእ፡ ሀካይ፡ እዴሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ኅፅኑ፡ ወኀበ፡ አፉሁ፡ ኢያቀርብ።
verses.translation: He that unjustly hides his hands in his bosom, will not even bring them up to his mouth.

translations.lxx: He that unjustly hides his hands in his bosom, will not even bring them up to his mouth.
translations.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
translations.ron: Leneşul întinde mâna în blid şi nu are putere s-o ducă la gură.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἐγκρύπτων εἰς τὸν κόλπον αὐτοῦ χεῖρας ἀδίκως, οὐδὲ τῷ στόματι οὐ μὴ προσενείκῃ αὐτάς.

verses.geez: ሕቡል፡ እንዘ፡ ይትቀሠፍ፡ ዐብድ፡ ጠቢበ፡ ይከውን፡ ወእመሰ፡ ዘለፍኮ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ይሔሊ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: When a pestilent character is scourged, a simple man is made wiser: and if thou reprove a wise man, he will understand discretion.

translations.lxx: When a pestilent character is scourged, a simple man is made wiser: and if thou reprove a wise man, he will understand discretion.
translations.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
translations.ron: Loveşte pe cel ce batjocoreşte şi cel fără de minte va deveni înţelept; mustră pe cel înţelept şi el va pricepe ştiinţa.
translations.grk: Λοιμοῦ μαστιγουμένου, ἄφρων πανουργότερος γίνεται· ἐὰν δὲ ἐλέγχῃς ἄνδρα φρόνιμον, νοήσει αἴσθησιν.

verses.geez: ዘያኀሥር፡ አባሁ፡ ወእሞ፡ ይትከላእ፡ ወይትኀፈር፡ ወምኑነ፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: He that dishonours his father, and drives away his mother, shall be disgraced and shall be exposed to reproach.

translations.lxx: He that dishonours his father, and drives away his mother, shall be disgraced and shall be exposed to reproach.
translations.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
translations.ron: Cel ce se poartă rău cu tatăl său şi alungă (din casă) pe mama sa, este fiu aducător de ocară şi de ruşine.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἀτιμάζων πατέρα καὶ ἀπωθούμενος μητέρα αὐτοῦ, καταισχυνθήσεται καὶ ἐπονείδιστος ἔσται.

verses.geez: ወልድ፡ ዘይትከላእ፡ እምዓቂበ፡ ትምህርተ፡ አብ፡ ይትሜሀር፡ ቃለ፡ እኩየ።
verses.translation: A son who ceases to attend to the instruction of a father will cherish evil designs.

translations.lxx: A son who ceases to attend to the instruction of a father will cherish evil designs.
translations.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
translations.ron: Încetează, fiul meu, să asculţi ademenirea şi să te laşi îndepărtat de învăţăturile înţelepte.
translations.grk: Υἱὸς ἀπολειπόμενος φυλάξαι παιδείαν πατρὸς, μελετήσει ῥήσεις κακάς.

verses.geez: ዘይትሄበይ፡ ዐብደ፡ ወልደ፡ ያጼእል፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወለአፈረሲዐን፡ ይውኅጦ፡ እኩይ፡ ኵነኔ።
verses.translation: He that becomes surety for a foolish child will despise the ordinance: and the mouth of ungodly men shall drink down judgments.

translations.lxx: He that becomes surety for a foolish child will despise the ordinance: and the mouth of ungodly men shall drink down judgments.
translations.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
translations.ron: Martorul de nimic îşi bate joc de dreptate şi gura celor fără de lege înghite nelegiuirea.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἐγγυώμενος παῖδα ἄφρονα, καθυβρίσει δικαίωμα· στόμα δὲ ἀσεβῶν καταπίεται κρίσεις.

verses.geez: ወይጸንሕ፡ ሎሙ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ለእኩያን፡ ወኵነኔ፡ ከማሁ፡ ለዐብዳን።
verses.translation: Scourges are preparing for the intemperate, and punishments likewise for fools.

translations.lxx: Scourges are preparing for the intemperate, and punishments likewise for fools.
translations.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
translations.ron: Pentru batjocoritori sunt gata toiege; loviturile sunt pentru spinarea celor nebuni.
translations.grk: Ἑτοιμάζονται ἀκολάστοις μάστιγες, καὶ τιμωρίαι ὁμοίως ἄφροσιν.
